Space Shooter is an exciting 2D arcade-style game where players take control of a spaceship and defend themselves against incoming enemies. The objective is to shoot down enemy spaceships before they cross the danger line and reach the player's territory. Players must react quickly, aim accurately, and use their shooting skills to survive and achieve a high score.

Survive the Ultimate Dodgeball Gauntlet!

Welcome to the arena! Ultimate Dodge is a fast-paced 3D arcade survival game that turns classic dodgeball into a high-intensity bullet hell. Play as Dodger—a plucky, visor-wearing hero with lightning reflexes, expressive cartoon flair, and an arsenal of reality-bending survival tricks.

Every second counts as dynamic, unpredictable hazards rain down. Chain close dodges to build your streak, charge your meter, and unleash game-saving skills when the arena erupts into total mayhem!

🌟 Key Features

⚽ The Ball Gauntlet: No two bounces are the same. Face off against an escalating roster of specialized threats:

🔥 Fire Balls: Coat the arena floor in scorching fire tiles that limit your running room.
🟢 Sticky Balls: Splash goop across the floor, threatening to slow you to a crawl.
☢️ Nuclear Balls: Ticking time-bombs that expand and detonate into arena-sweeping shockwaves—jump or perish!
🔫 Gun Balls: Ballistic turret balls that lock onto you and fire rapid-fire projectile volleys.
🧊 Ice & Spiked Balls: High-speed rebound nightmares designed to punish sloppy footwork.

🌀 Reality-Bending Survival Skills:

Dimension Shift (Phase): Slip into an alternate dimension, turning intangible and immune to incoming hazards while the arena shifts into surreal hues.
Dash Burst: Snap through tight projectile clusters with high-speed evasion trails.
Bullet-Time Slow Motion: Skim death by inches to fill your meter, then dilate time to weave through impossible crossfires in cinematic slo-mo.

🎯 High-Risk, High-Reward "Near-Miss" Streaks:

Shave centimeters off incoming projectiles to trigger satisfying near-miss stingers.
Chain your dodges to push your streak multiplier from 5x all the way to 20x GODLIKE STREAK!

💥 Slapstick Polish & "Juice":

Packed with screen shake, frame freezes (hit-stop), bouncy ragdoll-style impacts, expressive face animations, and comical sound bites (record scratches, cartoon bonks, and wah-wahs).
